title: Mango Lassi Smoothie Bowl
summary: A thick, spoonable Indian-inspired mango lassi bowl with creamy yoghurt, warm cardamom and a little crunch from nuts and seeds. It makes a refreshing vegetarian snack for warm afternoons or a light sweet treat.
steps: Put the mango, Greek yoghurt, milk, honey, cardamom and frozen banana into a blender.
Blend until completely smooth and thick, stopping to scrape down the sides if needed. The mixture should be spoonable rather than drinkable; add a splash more milk only if the blender struggles.
Taste and adjust with a little more honey if the mango is not very sweet.
Divide the smoothie mixture between two bowls and smooth the tops with the back of a spoon.
Scatter over the chopped pistachios, chia seeds and desiccated coconut, then serve immediately while cold and thick.
